ppo_training_episode_seeds: Drawn as int32 integers from RandStream('threefry', rl.seed + 404) with rl.seed = 20240501; not taken from the train split.
note: Each integer seed identifies a deterministic scenario via landing2d.scenario.sampleParameters(scenario, base_seed + seed) and a sensor-event/noise stream seeded with base_seed + seed + 1000000 (landing2d.environment.reset). Evaluation uses the first used_count seeds of each split. Test cases are never rejected based on policy performance.
